name: Adjacent Neighbors in Dimension 1
definition: A subroutine that determines the adjacent neighboring intervals around a given interval I within a collection of intervals I1, specifically for Dimension 1. It returns a pair of intervals (Cl, Cr) where Cl is adjacent to I on the left (between I and an interval from I1) and Cr is adjacent to I on the right.
summary: Adjacent Neighbors in Dimension 1 identifies empty integer intervals immediately adjacent to a query interval within a sorted collection, distinguishing itself by explicitly handling discrete integer boundaries and sign states.
